english.title: Drunk / disorderly person attempt to enter relevant premises after request not to do so - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, while drunk or disorderly, attempted to enter relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), after a request not to do so by

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[a person who worked at the premises in a capacity which authorised the making of such a request]_
(C)_[the holder of a premises licence in respect of those premises]_
(D)_[the designated premises supervisor of those premises]_
(E)_[a member or officer of the club which holds a club premises certificate and who is present on the premises in a capacity which enables him to make such a request]_
(F)_[the premises user where the premises are the subject of a permitted temporary activity under a temporary event notice]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 143(1)(b) and (3) of the Licensing Act 2003.
